John Stokes was, until recently, Professor of Modern British Literature at King's College London where he still teaches occasionally. He is also a Special Professor of  English and Drama at the University of Nottingham. His books include The French Actress and her English Audience (Cambridge University Press, 2005) and, together with Maggie Gale, he edited The Cambridge Companion to the Actress (Cambridge University Press, 2007). He is a regular theatre reviewer for the TLS.
